item.title: Liverpool’s Barcola fit for Brighton but Szoboszlai still sidelined
item.description:
Bradley Barcola will be available for Liverpool against Brighton, while Dominik Szoboszlai’s hamstring injury will keep him out until after the international break.

item.title: Storm Amy threatens Liverpool v Brighton at Anfield
item.description: Saturday’s match at Anfield could be postponed if forecasts of 80mph winds prove accurate, with a safety meeting scheduled for Friday afternoon.
